programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: The story is about Kunal (Kunal Khemu) who believes he can do anything by trying his hardest. He receives a job offer through his friend Shawn (Teeshay) and his wife Nandini (Puja Gupta (actress)) in Cape Town and moves there with his wife Aarzoo (Amrita Puri). They live a happy life together, until Kunal becomes extremely workaholic. Kunal's nature irritates Aarzoo which leads to frequent outbursts and quarrels. Kunal becomes the most trusted employee of his boss Dharmesh Zaveri (Manish Chaudhary). This thing angers Dinesh Zaveri, Dharmesh Zaveri's younger brother. Kunal advances in his job. Soon Dharmesh is revealed to be an underworld gangster. The company Kunal works in deals with exporting diamonds; Kunal has no idea that it happens illegally. His boss, Mr. Zakaria, sends his hot colleague Rosa to charm Kunal and take him away from his wife. Following the day when Kunal gets drunk in a party, Rosa takes advantage and manages to make love with him. Kunal reaches his house and finds Aarzoo sleeping and accidentally wakes her up, after which they both pick up a quarrel. Soon enough, Kunal realises the crime he is a part of and decides to and leave Cape Town. However, Zakaria knows that Kunal is aware of the illegal business and the only way to keep him silent is to kill him.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: Stealing Sinatra
programme.desc: In need of a grubstake, a young man convinces a couple of friends to help him kidnap Frank Sinatra Jr.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: The opening episode sees our experts examine how Henry VIII's traumatic childhood affected his personality – from the death of his older brother, which made him heir to the throne of England, to the tragic early death of his beloved mother. The effect of her death on Henry is dramatically revealed in a recent discovery of an extraordinary, illustrated manuscript portraying the young prince weeping inconsolably over her loss. Henry's complex relationship with his controlling father – Henry VII – is explored as he kept the teenage Henry as a virtual prisoner, passing on his own paranoia that would mark his son's personality for the rest of his life. As soon as his father dies and Henry becomes King Henry VIII, he brutally executes his father's closest advisors and issues a public proclamation criticising the old King's reign. Alongside death and fraught family relationships, this episode charts the extraordinary rise of Cardinal Wolsey – the son of a commoner who rises ruthlessly through the court to become Henry's chief advisor and closest friend. With exclusive access to the archives of the Vatican Library, Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman analyses an account from a foreign ambassador, which has never appeared on camera before – it reveals Wolsey's expertise in manipulating Henry and includes incredible detail about their complex personal relationship. Their friendship unravels however, when Wolsey fails to get Henry's divorce agreed so he can marry Anne Boleyn and Wolsey falls from Henry's grace as quickly as he rose. Strange quirks begin to appear in Henry's personality. He becomes obsessed with the problem that would dominate his reign – his lack of a male heir – and he becomes increasingly controlling, developing an unnerving habit of avoiding direct eye contact with others. In his rise to power, Henry has transformed from an anxious prince into a powerful monarch completely convinced of his own supremacy – but in the process, he will plunge the country into chaos.

programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: This episode takes viewers on a journey of marriage, affairs and tyrannical politics. It explores how Henry's obsession with marrying Anne Boleyn results in a cataclysmic and hugely unpopular split with the Roman Catholic Church, while his relationship with Anne turns from infatuation to deadly hatred. Tudor expert Dr Tracy Borman reveals the true nature of Henry's early infatuation when she visits the archives of the Vatican Library in Rome to catch a privileged glimpse of Henry's love letters to Anne. Henry also has a secret weapon, his new chief advisor and enforcer – Thomas Cromwell – who personally oversees the plunder and destruction of Catholic monasteries across the land. But, Henry's behaviour is becoming increasingly paranoid and tyrannical. Historian Dr Robert Hutchinson visits the Parliamentary Archives to see the legal document – The Treason Act – that turned Tudor England into a virtual dictatorship under Henry. He also examines a striking contemporary diary entry, which reveals that a jousting injury probably caused Henry to have a traumatic brain injury, making him irritable and suspicious of everyone around him. After the accident, Henry's court becomes a nest of vipers where no one is safe, particularly Anne Boleyn and Thomas Cromwell, who bear the brunt of the King's increasingly unhinged behaviour. Desperate to save his own neck, Thomas Cromwell plots against Anne, finding 'evidence' that she had an affair behind Henry's back with not one but five men. Anne is found guilty of treason and executed. Thomas Cromwell has out manoeuvred her, and Henry has got what he wanted – the chance for a new wife and a male heir.

programme.title: Prairie Fever
programme.desc: Western adventure starring Kevin Sorbo and Dominique Swain. A drunken former lawman is given the chance to clear his debts by escorting three eccentric women back East. (2008).

programme.title: The Hollywood Mom's Mystery
programme.desc: Lucy Freers has a long-standing marriage, a nine-year old daughter, and a great family life in the suburbs of Hollywood. Great, that is, until the Hollywood set decides that motherhood is the newest way to go. When local neighbor Julia Prentice, the wife of a famous movie actor, adopts a baby in full view of the show-business media, the parenthood craze hits its peak. Soon after, Julia is found lying dead in Lucy's swimming pool, with Lucy and her husband labeled as suspects. Now Lucy must determine the truth to clear the name of both herself and her family.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

programme.title: Sherlock Homes: The Case of the Whitechapel Vampire
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson are called to Whitechapel after learning about a series of strange murders only two years after the Jack the Ripper murders in the same neighborhood. The local belief is that the killings are the work of a vampire brought back from a recent mission in Guyana. As they investigate the deaths, they engage in an ongoing debate about the supernatural, with Watson believing in the possibility of vampires and Holmes remaining skeptical until he is able to prove the murders are the works of a living human, rather than any undead creature. At one point, the investigation leads them to the psychic Madame Karasky, who says that Holmes will be saved by the church. Shortly thereafter, Holmes is pushed in front of a moving carriage by the supposed vampire, only to be saved by a pedestrian. In order to catch the murderer, Holmes disguises himself as a monk and reveals that the vampire was Brother Abel, who hoped to get revenge on the monks who didn't listen to him when he believed that the bats were causing rabies in the South American mission, when he was infected. The film ends at Baker Street, when Mrs. Hudson gives Holmes his pipe, delivered by the same man that saved Holmes from being run over. When Holmes asks his name, Mrs. Hudson says his name was Reginald Church.

programme.title: Hogfather

programme.title: The Hot Potato
programme.desc: London's East End 1969. Based on real events. Two chancers "find" a lump of Uranium and crisscross Europe to find a buyer. Accompanied by Danny's girl,the lovely Carole. They encounter a diverse cast of bizarre characters, all trying to steal the 'Hot Potato', but a deal agreed inside the Vatican has the co-conspirators confounding each other. The story twists and turns to an exciting and unexpected finale.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno (star of the 1970s/80s TV series The Incredible Hulk), Sybil Danning, Ingrid Anderson and Mirella D'Angelo take the lead roles in Italian writer-director Luigi Cozzi's mythological romp for the low-budget action specialists The Cannon Group. The narrative starts with the creation of the universe, at the end of which Pandora's jar is broken, releasing evil into the world. Greek god Zeus (Claudio Cassinelli) decides to protect mankind from evil by creating a hero and sends divine light down to Bronze Age Thebes, where it enters the body of a royal baby. The infant survives a bloody palace coup instigated by Adriana (Danning), daughter of a rival monarch, and the malicious interventions of Zeus's wronged wife Hera (Rossana Podestŕ) to become the immensely strong Hercules (Ferrigno). But adulthood doesn't see an end to the relentless campaign to destroy him. And when Adriana captures his love Cassiopea (Anderson), Hercules joins forces with the sorceress Circe (D'Angelo) to save Cassiopea.

They enter college together, where Katie is a prized legacy candidate for the Delta sorority, which was co-founded decades ago by her mother, Lutie (Courtney Thorne-Smith) and Summer (Faith Ford), whose own daughter Gwen (Amanda Schull) now leads the Deltas on campus. Katie joins the rival Kappa sorority, and the rivalry splits not just Katie and Sara, but extends all the way into the Delta alumnae association led by Lutie and Summer.

programme.title: Hard Ground
programme.desc: Billy Bucklin escapes while being transported to Yuma prison and plans to form an army of desperadoes to control the Mexican border. To finance his band, he robs a stagecoach, kidnaps a beautiful woman to be sold into prostitution, and steals an army payroll wagon. An aging lawman persuades the governor to parole his brother-in-law, now serving a 20-year prison term for murder, to assist him and his green deputy to destroy the marauders.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Missie's (Erin Cottrell) surprise discovery - her pregnancy - sets her on a new course that's at once thrilling and terrifying. After all the planning and dreaming, she and her husband, Willie (Logan Bartholomew), have headed west in a covered wagon, leaving behind the prairie home of Missie's parents. Later on they meet Jeff Huff and his older brother Sonny. They later make new friends and spend Christmas together.

programme.title: For One Night
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of an African American teenager who shook up a small town where high school proms had been racially segregated for decades. Amid the protests of the community and with the help of a newspaper reporter who returns to her hometown to cover the story, the two women are able to reverse decades of racist tradition and make history, at least for one night. The movie is based on events that occurred in Taylor County, Georgia in 2002.

Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: The Ten Commandments
programme.desc: One of the most famous stories from The Bible, this mini-series sees the Hebrew infant, Moses, being raised in the Egyptian royal household. When his true identity is revealed, he sets out to reclaim his heritage. Later, the plagues descend on Egypt, and Pharaoh frees the Hebrews only to change his mind and pursue them to the Red Sea where the parting of the waves ensures their escape. After receiving the Ten Commandments, Moses faces an orgy of excess amongst his tribe.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: Elizabeth remains a threat in her childless Catholic sister's eyes. Queen Mary is still on the throne and with her harsh politics, she excessively pursues the persecution of Protestants, even of her sister. Queen Mary knows that her sister has a large number of supporters in England, and therefore, she imprisons Elizabeth in the tower and later puts her under house arrest. When Queen Mary surprisingly dies from a tumor, Elizabeth becomes Queen of England. William Cecil, her advisor, warns Elizabeth of the dangers that the married Robert Dudley may, due to their inappropriate relation, cause as a member of the Privy Council.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: The pressure on Elizabeth grows as there is still no marriage and consequently no heir to the throne. Elizabeth fears that her cousin Mary Queen of Scots, recently widowed, might claim her right to the throne of England. However she is resolute in thinking that she can rule alone. Meanwhile she continues to meet Robert Dudley. When his wife dies, rumors spread that Elizabeth might be behind her death. Details of a plot to replace Elizabeth with Mary are uncovered by Walsingham. Even the Duke of Norfolk seems to be involved and is subsequently sent to the tower.

programme.title: Answered by Fire
programme.desc: Canadian RCMP officer Zoe Brennan, Australian Federal Policeman Mark Waldman and a young East Timorese translator named Ismenio Soares are brought together by the UN's fateful effort to give the Timorese a voice in their own future. In the chaotic run-up to the vote, these initially reluctant partners become real friends. But when the UN evacuates in the post-ballot rampage, Mark and Zoe are forced to abandon Ismenio and his family to a nightmarish fate. Haunted by guilt, the two westerners each find their way back to Timor, driven to make amends to the people they tried - and failed - to protect.

programme.title: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 5
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris" - Paryžiaus „Paris Basketball"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Madrido „Real“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Wimbledon. No.2 Court
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Kauno „Žalgiris“ - Madrido „Real“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: The Brotherhood. An undeniable band-of-brothers that enhances their odds of survival against the larger super-predators of the savanna. But no partnership comes without its challenges and leadership amongst the group is not a done deal either.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Compilations
programme.desc: Our world is home to an array of wild creatures…creatures that have evolved to survive amid harsh environments, and brutal competition. But in every region resides an elite group of twelve species -- an assembly of mammals, reptiles, insects, and arachnids-- equipped with an arsenal of predatory and defensive skills. They're beautiful, they're highly evolved, and they're dangerous-they are the Deadly Dozen.

programme.title: World's Biggest Great White?
programme.desc: Three experienced divers and photographers set out on a small boat to try to record any marine life around the carcass of a sperm whale floating off the coast of Oahu. What they experienced is one of the most incredible great white shark encounters ever caught on camera.

programme.title: Bull Shark vs. Hammerhead
programme.desc: A rare event between top ocean predators was captured on video in Florida: bull sharks attacking a great hammerhead. Dr. Heithaus and a team of shark experts launch an investigation pinning one against the other. They put experiments to the test to see what will happen when these top predators come head-to-head.

programme.title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most dangerous mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean's most famous and fearsome predators: the great white shark. Bertie will attempt to film them hunting seals underwater without the use of a protective cage. It's highly risky, but filming without the cage is the very best way to see them behaving naturally.

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: In Gracetown, Australia, two surfers are attacked just a few hours apart on the same beach. In New South Wales, another surfer has a close call when a great white takes a bite of his board. And in Tampa, Florida, a juvenile bull shark injures a girl paddleboarding with her family. At surf spots across the globe, sharks attack surfers at alarming rates. Recent data shows surfers account for a third of unprovoked shark bites worldwide. What is it about riding the breaks that has sharks seeing red? Researchers investigate terrifying close calls and gruesome attacks from America to Australia. They examine evidence and test theories to learn why surfers remain high on the shark hit list, all in the hope of saving lives.

programme.title: Return of the White Shark
programme.desc: Cape Cod — America's Playground — is a newly emerging hotspot for a top predator. Great Whites are appearing in increasing numbers, when for centuries there were none. Through spectacular imagery, we'll see how the landscape of Cape Cod has changed over time, and what is luring Great Whites in record numbers.

programme.desc: The 7,000 islands of the Philippines are home to over 25,000 species that are found nowhere else on earth. programme.title: Something Bit Me!

programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: World's Deadliest Whale
programme.desc: Intelligent, cultured and deadly, the killer whale dominates every ocean on earth and as our planet changes, this top predator changes with it. They are elite, marine hunters with an extremely diverse diet including other apex predators like the great white shark. Killer whales pursue their prey like a pack of wolves and have multiple killing techniques.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. In the Gesäuse National Park Avalanches created one of the most species-rich habitats, which rare butterflies like the Red Apollo colonize.

programme.title: Race to Winter
programme.desc: As the first light of spring touches snow-covered landscapes, the race begins. Across fjords, forests, mountains and tundra, animals emerge from hiding to take advantage of summer's fleeting generosity. But the clock is ticking, and winter is never far away. Brown bear mothers supervise their wayward cubs; puffins reunite in lifelong pairs atop perilous ledges; a polar bear mother searches for food in a land where the ice has receded and her usual prey has vanished. As summer fades, the mighty moose faces wolves in the silent snow. Arctic foxes raise their young and scavenge in brutal temperatures, surviving on scraps others cannot digest. Each species is tied to the land and to each other in a delicate web of survival. In this race against the cold, only the most remarkable endure.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most dangerous mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean's most famous and fearsome predators: the great white shark. Bertie will attempt to film them hunting seals underwater without the use of a protective cage. It's highly risky, but filming without the cage is the very best way to see them behaving naturally.

programme.title: Shark Attack Files
programme.desc: In Gracetown, Australia, two surfers are attacked just a few hours apart on the same beach. In New South Wales, another surfer has a close call when a great white takes a bite of his board. And in Tampa, Florida, a juvenile bull shark injures a girl paddleboarding with her family. At surf spots across the globe, sharks attack surfers at alarming rates. Recent data shows surfers account for a third of unprovoked shark bites worldwide. What is it about riding the breaks that has sharks seeing red? Researchers investigate terrifying close calls and gruesome attacks from America to Australia. They examine evidence and test theories to learn why surfers remain high on the shark hit list, all in the hope of saving lives.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Best friends and cadets-in-training Swift, Penny, Rod, and Brody congregate at Top Wing Academy, where they learn what it takes to gain their wings and become rescue birds on Big Swirl Island. Swift is a blue jay and the fastest pilot at the academy; Penny, the only female in the group, is a penguin, and she is an expert at undersea life; Brody is a puffin who takes a more land approach, and Rod is a rooster who is ready to fly around Big Swirl Island in his all-terrain vehicle. The four friends are joined by their mentor Speedy, who helps the cadets on their different missions. "Top Wing" focuses on the importance of teamwork and the ability to successfully solve problems.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: On a fairy family trip to Fairy World, Dev convinces Hazel to steal Peri's wand and explore Fairy World. Cosmo, Wanda and Peri sneak into Jorgen's office and use his tracker to find them. Hazel and Dev end up stuck in the Un-Wish Zone, trapped by the Un-wish Dragon. Together they must battle the dragon and find their way back to their fairies before Jorgen finds out! // When band and orchestra tryouts happen at school, Hazel finds herself stuck in the middle of a rivalry between the two. Rather than choose a side, she wishes to be good at all instruments and ends up in both. Exhausted from the double life she's living, she wishes that the band and orchestra had nothing to be rivals about. In granting the wish, Cosmo and Wanda get rid of all music on Earth. Hazel, with the help of the Nmusic Phairy (silent N), must restore music to Earth and end this rivalry once and for all!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: During a visit from Antony, Hazel's wish lands them inside "Rattleconda Racers," a board game they invented. Once in the game, however, they bicker about the best way to play. Hazel wants to stick to the rules they used to play by, but Antony wants to make new ones. When the formidable Rhonda the Rattleconda takes off with Cosmo and Wanda, intending to make them her next meal, Hazel and Antony must confront the tension in their relationship to save them and escape the game! // When Hazel must give a presentation on what she wants to be when she grows up, she is excited to share her dreams of being a geologist! Wanting to wow her classmates, she wishes she could excavate an "out of this world" rock to show them. Cosmo and Wanda poof her underground to find a super special rock, and she does! But in the process, she angers a group of rock monsters and must use her knowledge of geology to win them over, get her rock back, and escape the cave!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: The Patty Caper: The Krabby Patty formula has been placed in a vault far away for safe keeping. When Mr. Krabs forgets the recipe, he gives SpongeBob the key to the vault and sends him on a train ride to retrieve the formula. But someone steals the key! It's a mystery-aboard-a-train story as SpongeBob tries to locate the culprit, and he does it with the unlikeliest of allies ... Plankton! Plankton's Regular: Plankton has a customer who loves his chum and eats at the Chum Bucket every day-and no one is more surprised than Plankton. Could this mean competition for the Krusty Krab?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Boating Buddies: In an attempt to get away from SpongeBob, Squidward drives off in his boat as fast as he can. But he's stopped in his tracks when he's pulled over by a cop and is ordered to go to boating school. Now Squidward has to sit next to SpongeBob in class all day long and SpongeBob couldn't be happier! The Krabby Kronicle: When Mr. Krabs notices that the citizens of Bikini Bottom love buying tabloid newspapers, he decides to begin another business venture-his own tabloid! He recruits SpongeBob as his writer, but SpongeBob doesn't feel comfortable making up stories about other people because that would make him a liar. But Mr. Krabs assures him that making up stories for the paper isn't lying, it's using your imagination! SpongeBob discovers that making up stories about the people in Bikini Bottom is a lot of fun-but the people he's writing about don't think so.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un action nel segno della magia con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Daniel Radcliffe e i premi Oscar Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.title: Anemone
programme.desc: Ray, ex soldato britannico, si è da tempo autoesiliato dalla famiglia e dalla società. Quando Jem, il fratello, parte alla sua ricerca, segreti nascosti e rancori sepolti da tempo vengono alla luce.

programme.title: Dragon Trainer
programme.desc: Mason Thames e Gerard Butler nell'emozionante live action che riporta in scena la storia dell’amata trilogia di animazione. Sull'isola di Berk, dove vichinghi e draghi sono acerrimi nemici da generazioni, il giovane Hiccup sfida la tradizione facendo amicizia con il temibile drago Furia Buia.

programme.title: Robin Hood principe dei ladri
programme.desc: Kevin Costner, Alan Rickman e Morgan Freeman nell'avventuroso cult anni 90. Robin Hood addestra un gruppo di ribelli per sconfiggere la tirannia dello sceriffo di Nottingham.

programme.desc: Agathe è affascinante quanto contraddittoria. È single, ma sogna una storia d'amore degna dei romanzi di Jane Austen. È libraia, ma sogna di diventare scrittrice. Ha un'immaginazione sfrenata, ma una sessualità inesistente.

programme.desc: Tahar Rahim (Il profeta) è Charles Aznavour. Dalla difficile infanzia nella Parigi popolare all’incontro con Édith Piaf, il viaggio umano e artistico di un’icona senza tempo.

programme.desc: Esordio al cinema per Whitney Houston, con Kevin Costner in un cult romantico degli anni 90. Un ex federale viene incaricato di proteggere una popstar minacciata da un maniaco.

programme.title: Io sono nessuno 2
programme.desc: L'assassino stacanovista Hutch Mansell porta la famiglia in vacanza. L'uomo si ritrova presto nel mirino del gestore di un parco divertimenti, di uno sceriffo losco e di un boss della malavita.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: Due senzatetto, un immigrato nigeriano e una tossicodipendente, si innamorano a New York. A poco a poco, si scopre come sono arrivati in questa situazione e si rendono conto che hanno bisogno l'uno dell'altra per andare avanti.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Penguin Bloom
programme.desc: Naomi Watts e Andrew Lincoln in un'emozionante storia vera. Paralizzata a causa di un incidente, una donna trova il coraggio di ricominciare prendendosi cura di una gazza ferita.

programme.title: Il caso Spotlight
programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.title: What They Had
programme.desc: Hilary Swank e Michael Shannon in un dramma familiare. Tornata nella casa di Chicago per gestire la malattia della madre, Bridget è costretta a fare i conti con rancori mai sopiti.

programme.title: Grease - Brillantina
programme.desc: L'intramontabile musical con John Travolta e Olivia Newton-John. Una high school nell'America degli anni '50 incornicia le vicende amorose fra la romantica Sandy e lo spavaldo Danny Zuko.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: I guerrieri della notte
programme.desc: Capolavoro di Walter Hill e un classico dell'action. New York: accusati di omicidio, i Warriors devono sfuggire alla ritorsione delle bande rivali nel corso di una lunga notte di agguati.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Leonardo DiCaprio nel biopic di Martin Scorsese con Margot Robbie. L'incredibile ascesa di Jordan Belfort, un broker attratto dalla sete di potere e da una vita dissoluta.

programme.title: Limonov
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Emmanuel Carrère, Kirill Serebrennikov dirige un film sulla travolgente vita dello scrittore e politico Eduard Limonov (Ben Whishaw) tra Russia, America ed Europa.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.desc: Due Oscar al biopic di Oliver Stone con Tom Cruise. La vera storia di Ron Kovic: rimasto paralizzato nell'inferno del Vietnam, torna in patria e diventa un leader pacifista.

programme.desc: Estate, fine anni Ottanta. Un ex tennista, deluso dalla sua mediocre carriera, diventa l'allenatore di un giovane talento timido, schiacciato dalle aspettative del padre. I due affrontano le loro paure e insicurezze.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Il postino
programme.desc: Il commovente addio al cinema di Massimo Troisi in un film emozionante con Philippe Noiret e Maria Grazia Cucinotta. Il compianto attore partenopeo interpreta Mario, un umile postino che instaura un intenso rapporto d'amicizia con il poeta cileno Pablo Neruda, in esilio su un'isola nel Golfo di Napoli. Nei frequenti colloqui con l'artista Mario impara la magia della poesia, mentre una bellissima ragazza del luogo entra nella sua vita. Nel frattempo, la conclusione del confino separera' i due amici lasciando al destino la possibilita' di rivedersi di nuovo. Oscar alle musiche di Luis Bacalov.

programme.title: La battaglia di Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al War movie di Mel Gibson con Andrew Garfield, da una storia vera. Seconda guerra mondiale: un soldato ottiene la medaglia al valore malgrado il rifiuto di impugnare le armi.

programme.title: Bugonia
programme.desc: Due uomini ossessionati dalle teorie complottistiche rapiscono l'amministratrice delegata di una grande azienda, convinti che sia un'aliena che vuole distruggere la Terra.

programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.desc: La genesi ossessiva della celebre partitura di Maurice Ravel nel biopic di Anne Fontaine. La vita, la carriera e il tormento creativo dell'artista, fino al suo capolavoro musicale.

programme.desc: Gioia, un'insegnante di letteratura francese, instaura un legame proibito, fragile e inspiegabilmente necessario con Alessio, un suo studente. Quest'ultimo però distrugge tutto e cancella l'unica persona che lo abbia mai amato.

programme.desc: Walter Salles dirige Fernanda Torres in una storia vera premiata a Venezia e con l'Oscar 2025. Brasile, 1971: un giorno, all'improvviso, Rubens Paiva viene prelevato da casa.

programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige il premio Oscar Geoffrey Rush in un'intensa pellicola. La vita di un antiquario viene sconvolta dal segreto nascosto nei sotterranei di una villa.

programme.desc: 7 Oscar e Orso d'argento a Berlino a un'epica love story con Gwyneth Paltrow e un grande cast. Londra, 1593. In crisi creativa, Shakespeare trova l'ispirazione grazie all'amore per Viola.

programme.desc: La storia della guerra civile dei Targaryen, avvenuta 200 anni prima degli eventi descritti ne "Il trono di spade". Qui, i sostenitori di Aegon si scontrano con quelli della sua sorellastra Rhaenyra per il trono di Viserys I, il loro defunto padre.

programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Miami supercops: I poliziotti dell'8a strada
programme.desc: Doug e Steve sono grandi amici: il primo lavora per l'FBI, il secondo ha lasciato l'agenzia perché nauseato dalla burocrazia che, secondo lui, lega le mani alla giustizia. La riapertura di un caso, però, richiede l'esperienza e l'astuzia di entrambi.

programme.title: Il codice da Vinci
programme.desc: Tom Hanks in un thriller di Ron Howard tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Per scagionarsi da un'accusa di omicidio, un esperto di simbologia dovra' svelare uno sconcertante segreto.

programme.title: C'è post@ per te
programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.title: Intervista a Matilda De Angelis
programme.desc: Matilda De Angelis, protagonista del film "La lezione" con Stefano Accorsi, ci racconta aneddoti e curiosità sul set del thriller diretto da Stefano Mordini.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Non così vicino
programme.desc: Marc Forster dirige Tom Hanks in una pellicola dolceamara. Dopo la morte della moglie, Otto è un uomo rigido e solo. Ma la sua vita sarà sconvolta dall’arrivo di una nuova vicina.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Meryl Streep e Tom Hanks in un capolavoro sulla libertà di stampa. 1971: il Washington Post entra in possesso di documenti del Pentagono sulla guerra in Vietnam.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Tom Hanks nel terzo thriller tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Firenze: il professor Langdon deve fermare un folle scienziato ossessionato dall'inferno di Dante.

programme.desc: Animali domestici all'arrembaggio nel successo d'animazione targato Illumination. Il tenero cagnolino Max si allea con il randagio Duke per fermare il piano del coniglio Nevosetto.

programme.desc: Grande successo per il quinto capitolo del franchise Illumination con le amate creature gialle. Los Angeles, anni '70: l'adolescente Gru cresce in perfidia e sogna di entrare nei Malefici 6.

programme.title: Sing
programme.desc: Dai creatori di "Cattivissimo me", una commedia musicale sulla magia del palcoscenico. In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Bambi - Una vita nei boschi
programme.desc: Un piccolo cerbiatto di nome Bambi è appena venuto al mondo. Con l'aiuto dei suoi amici, Bambi vivrà ogni tipo di avventura che lo preparerà ad assumere il suo ruolo di principe della foresta.

programme.title: Vicky e il suo cucciolo
programme.desc: Toccante storia di amicizia sui monti del Cantal. Dopo la morte della madre, la piccola Victoria si e' chiusa nel mutismo. Un cucciolo di lupo le restituira' la voce e il sorriso.

programme.title: Trolls World Tour
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo d'animazione con le bambole targate Dreamworks. Poppy e Branch scoprono l'esistenza di sei diverse tribu' di Trolls, ognuna dedicata a un genere musicale: Pop, Funk, Musica classica, Techno, Country e Hard Rock. E proprio la tribu' dei rockettari, guidata da Re Trash (doppiato da Ozzy Osbourne nella versione originale) e dalla Regina Barb, ha elaborato il piu' cattivo dei propositi: regnare su tutti gli altri Trolls, eliminando gli altri generi musicali affinche' il rock regni. Poppy e Branch e tutti i loro amici si impegneranno per far prevalere l'armonia.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Megamind
programme.desc: Allegra parodia del mondo dei supereroi in un gioiello d'animazione DreamWorks. Annoiato dalla mancanza di un rivale, Megamind ne crea uno grazie al dna del nemico sconfitto, Metroman.

programme.desc: Gilles de Maistre firma un inno alla bellezza della natura e all'amicizia tra uomo e animale. Cina: lo svogliato dodicenne Tian, sempre distratto dai videogame, viene mandato dalla nonna sulle montagne del Sichuan dove stringe un legame profondo con un cucciolo di panda.

programme.title: 10 giorni senza mamma
programme.desc: Fabio De Luigi e Valentina Lodovini nella commedia campione d'incassi di Alessandro Genovesi. Giulia si concede una vacanza a Cuba lasciando il marito ad occuparsi dei figli.

programme.title: Willy Wonka e la fabbrica di cioccolato
programme.desc: Gene Wilder in un inno alla fantasia, dal romanzo di Roald Dahl. Lo stravagante Willy Wonka accompagna cinque bambini in un tour all'interno della sua inaccessibile fabbrica di dolciumi.

programme.title: Il cacciatore e la regina di ghiaccio
programme.desc: Prequel di 'Biancaneve e il cacciatore' con Charlize Theron, Chris Hemsworth e Jessica Chastain. Un cacciatore e una guerriera difendono la Terra incantata da due streghe maligne.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Bla Bla Baby
programme.desc: Commedia di Fausto Brizzi con Alessandro Preziosi e Matilde Gioli. Dopo aver ingerito degli omogeneizzati contaminati, il maestro di un asilo nido inizia a decifrare le urla dei bambini.

programme.title: Free Willy: Un amico da salvare
programme.desc: L'incredibile storia d'amicizia tra un ragazzino ribelle e un'orca. Incaricato della pulizia di un acquario, Jesse fa amicizia con Willy, un'orca capace di mirabolanti esibizioni.

programme.title: Schegge di paura
programme.desc: Richard Gere ed Edward Norton, premiato con il Golden Globe, in un classico thriller giudiziario. Un avvocato accetta di difendere gratis un chierichetto, un giovane schizofrenico affetto da personalita' multipla, accusato dell'omicidio dell'arcivescovo di Chicago. Le prove dell'accusa contro il ragazzo sono schiaccianti, ma la partita in tribunale e' tutta da giocare, anche perche' la verita' e' molto piu' complessa e sorprendente. E soprattutto non e' quella che sembra. Film d'esordio per Norton, che ottenne anche la nomination agli Oscar come miglior attore non protagonista.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.title: Presence

programme.title: Flight Risk - Trappola ad alta quota
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg, Michelle Dockey e Topher Grace in un action di Mel Gibson. Un agente federale sta scortando a bordo di un piccolo aereo un testimone chiave nel processo contro un clan mafioso, ma il pilota del velivolo si rivela un sicario incaricato di uccidere il pentito.

programme.title: Boston - Caccia all'uomo
programme.desc: Mark Wahlberg e Kevin Bacon nel thriller che ricostruisce l'attentato di Boston. Aprile 2013: durante la maratona, due bombe provocano tre vittime. FBI e polizia braccano i colpevoli.

programme.desc: Intrighi da Guerra Fredda nello spy-thriller di Alfred Hitchcock. Un agente segreto francese, in missione per conto della Cia, scopre l'esistenza di missili sovietici a Cuba.

programme.title: Innamorarsi
programme.desc: Un'intensa storia romantica con la straordinaria coppia da Oscar, Robert De Niro-Meryl Streep. Lui ingegnere, lei disegnatrice pubblicitaria, si incontrano casualmente in una libreria di New York, alla vigilia di Natale. Si rivedono poi ogni giorno, sul treno per andare a lavoro. Entrambi sposati, si innamorano sia pure tra mille riserve che alla fine prendono il sopravvento. Tra loro cala il silenzio, ma il destino li fara' incontrare ancora un anno piu' tardi... David di Donatello alla Streep come miglior attrice straniera.

programme.title: La verità è che non gli piaci abbastanza
programme.desc: Spumeggiante commedia romantica con Jennifer Aniston, Ben Affleck, Jennifer Connelly e Scarlett Johansson. A Baltimora si intrecciano le vicende amorose di un gruppo di donne.

programme.title: Intervista Jasmine Trinca-Andrea De Sica

programme.title: Book Club - Tutto puo' succedere
programme.desc: Diane Keaton e Jane Fonda guidano un cast di superstar hollywoodiane in una commedia spensierata sulla riscoperta della sessualita'. Quattro amiche che da tantissimi anni amano discutere di libri, decidono di calarsi nella lettura di uno dei fenomeni letterari del ventunesimo secolo: il famigerato romanzo erotico "Cinquanta sfumature di grigio". Scorrere quelle pagine piccanti, sviscerarne ogni dettaglio non le lascera' affatto indifferenti ma le spingera' ad assecondare le loro piu' capricciose curiosita', cogliendo l'occasione per dare una svolta alla loro routine.

Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

Ike Graham e' un cronista di New York in cerca di un'idea per il prossimo pezzo da consegnare al suo capo, la sua ex moglie. Per caso, in un bar, sente parlare di una donna, Maggie Carpenter, che piu' di una volta ha abbandonato sull'altare i suoi fidanzati. Ike le dedica il suo prossimo articolo, finendo per scatenare l'ira della donna che ne ottiene il licenziamento. Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

Hannah, la giovane vedova dell'acclamato folk singer Hunter Miles, sta scrivendo la biografia del defunto marito nel tentativo di elaborare il lutto che la tormenta. Alla stesura collabora Andrew, uno scrittore e professore universitario che cerchera' di incrinare il guscio di rabbia e solitudine in cui Hannah si e' rinchiusa. Non solo per ultimare il libro, ma soprattutto per aiutarla a rifarsi una vita. Opera prima di Sean Mewshaw, assistente alla regia di Martin Scorsese in "Gangs of New York".

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Mr Cobbler e la bottega magica
programme.desc: Adam Sandler vive mille avventure in una commedia fantastica dal regista premio Oscar per "Il caso Spotlight". Max Simkin e' un solitario calzolaio newyorkese che conduce una vita grigia e monotona. Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: All About Love
programme.desc: Kikay and Kiko grew up together in the province and built a strong friendship. But Kikay has to leave her best friend to live and study in Manila. She tries to fit in her new environment in the city but she ends up being abused by the people she thought as her new friends. Kikay returns to the province with a wounded self-esteem. There, she realizes how much Kiko loves her. Feeling unworthy of his love, Kikay drives Kiko away. But will she ever find the courage to come face to face with her own problems and admit her love for him?

programme.title: #Walang Forever
programme.desc: Mia, a celebrated writer of romantic-comedy films, is at a turning point in her life which makes it difficult for her to believe that love could last. Everything comes to a head when Ethan returns, only for her to find out that he has become a cynic of lasting love because she broke his heart.

programme.title: Ang Dalawang Mrs. Reyes
programme.desc: After discovering their husbands have been having an affair with each other, two friends attempt to sabotage the relationship.

programme.title: You're My Boss
programme.desc: A lowly assistant and his domineering boss are forced to switch places in order to win over an important client.

programme.title: Kabisera (2013)
programme.desc: A fisherman finds himself in possession of a large amount of meth. He sees the drugs as the key to building a better life for his family, but his ambitions grow greater than that noble goal.
